'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Barry Alperstein LS Yavin 4 (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Barry Alperstein]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4 (V) (Virtual Block 7)|Yavin 4 (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
